workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: Q₀ 與製冷電力練習：1.3 GHz 九腔在 2.0 K，用 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω 得 R_BCS ≈ 11 nΩ；假設 R_res = 4 nΩ，R_s = 15 nΩ，Q₀ = G/R_s = 270/15×10⁻⁹ = 1.8×10¹⁰。在 E_acc = 16 MV/m、L = 1.038 m 下 V = 16.6 MV，P_diss = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×1.8×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/1.86×10¹³ ≈ 14.8 W。一個 8 腔模組動態負載 118 W，加靜態 10 W 為 128 W；以每瓦 2 K 需 700 W 電力估計，製冷電力約 90 kW。若殘餘電阻因磁通捕獲升到 14 nΩ，R_s = 25 nΩ，Q₀ 降到 1.08×10¹⁰，模組電力升到約 146 kW。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Q₀ and refrigeration exercise: a 1.3 GHz nine-cell at 2.0 K has R_BCS ≈ 11 nΩ from R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω; assuming R_res = 4 nΩ, R_s = 15 nΩ and Q₀ = G/R_s = 270/15×10⁻⁹ = 1.8×10¹⁰. At E_acc = 16 MV/m and L = 1.038 m, V = 16.6 MV and P_diss = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×1.8×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/1.86×10¹³ ≈ 14.8 W. An 8-cavity module then has 118 W dynamic plus 10 W static load, 128 W; at an assumed 700 W of electricity per watt at 2 K the refrigeration draws about 90 kW. If trapped flux raises the residual resistance to 14 nΩ, R_s = 25 nΩ, Q₀ falls to 1.08×10¹⁰ and the module's electrical demand rises to about 146 kW. Values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」與「表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity" and "Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TESLA 型加速腔由九個橢圓形腔室以 π 模式串接，長度約 1.038 m，在 1.3 GHz 下建立沿軸的加速電場 E_acc。腔壁為鈮，臨界溫度 9.25 K，浸在 2 K 的超流氦中；壁面電流只在約 40 nm 的穿透深度內流動，表面電阻為奈歐姆等級，使品質因數 Q₀ 達 10¹⁰ 量級。系統邊界包括射頻功率耦合器、高階模耦合器、氦槽與調諧器；進入腔壁的功率全部變成 2 K 熱負載，而 2 K 製冷每瓦要花數百瓦電力，所以 Q₀ 是整個設計的經濟核心。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A TESLA-type cavity chains nine elliptical cells in the π mode over about 1.038 m and builds the on-axis accelerating field E_acc at 1.3 GHz. The wall is niobium with a critical temperature of 9.25 K, immersed in 2 K superfluid helium; wall current flows only within the roughly 40 nm penetration depth, the surface resistance is at the nano-ohm level, and the quality factor Q₀ reaches the 10¹⁰ range. The system boundary includes the RF power coupler, higher-order-mode couplers, helium vessel and tuner; every watt dissipated in the wall becomes a 2 K heat load, and 2 K refrigeration costs several hundred watts of electricity per watt, so Q₀ is the economic core of the design. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A superconducting cavity has zero resistance, so RF power does not heat the wall." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity" is correct?
options: 超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。

steps.title: 超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。取 E_acc = 16 MV/m、L = 1.038 m（V = 16.6 MV）、R/Q = 1036 Ω、Q₀ = 2.7×10¹⁰：P = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/2.80×10¹³ ≈ 9.9 W（連續波）。若 Q₀ 只有 1×10¹⁰，同樣梯度下耗散升到約 27 W。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L. For E_acc = 16 MV/m, L = 1.038 m (V = 16.6 MV), R/Q = 1036 Ω and Q₀ = 2.7×10¹⁰: P = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/2.80×10¹³ ≈ 9.9 W in continuous-wave operation. With Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰ the same gradient dissipates about 27 W. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans；同時以氦槽壓力與蒸發流量做量熱法交叉比對，兩者差異應在 10% 以內，再把 P_diss 代回公式反算 Q₀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers; in steady state P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

For E_acc = 16 MV/m, L = 1.038 m (V = 16.6 MV), R/Q = 1036 Ω and Q₀ = 2.7×10¹⁰: P = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/2.80×10¹³ ≈ 9.9 W in continuous-wave operation. knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity", which statement holds?
options: 焊接後只要把表面打磨光亮，射頻性能就會好。
鈮腔是剛性金屬，射頻場不可能改變它的形狀與頻率。
腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。
optionsEn: After welding, a mirror-bright mechanical polish is enough for good RF performance.
A niobium cavity is rigid metal, so the RF field cannot change its shape or frequency.
Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L.
quiz.explanation: 腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans；同時以氦槽壓力與蒸發流量做量熱法交叉比對，兩者差異應在 10% 以內，再把 P_diss 代回公式反算 Q₀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers; in steady state P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans. Cross-check calorimetrically from helium bath pressure and boil-off flow, require agreement within about 10%, then invert the formula to obtain Q₀. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把射頻耗散當成「可忽略的小量」而只按靜態熱負載設計低溫系統，實機在高梯度連續波運轉時 2 K 氦槽壓力無法維持，腔體被迫降梯度或脈衝化運轉。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Treating RF dissipation as negligible and sizing the cryogenics only for static load leaves the 2 K bath unable to hold pressure at high-gradient CW operation, forcing the cavity to lower gradient or pulsed duty.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans；同時以氦槽壓力與蒸發流量做量熱法交叉比對，兩者差異應在 10% 以內，再把 P_diss 代回公式反算 Q₀。
knowledge.textEn: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers; in steady state P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans. Cross-check calorimetrically from helium bath pressure and boil-off flow, require agreement within about 10%, then invert the formula to obtain Q₀.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity"?
options: 在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
垂直測試合格的腔，裝進模組後性能一定相同。
optionsEn: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A cavity that passed the vertical test will perform identically inside the module.
quiz.explanation: 在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans；同時以氦槽壓力與蒸發流量做量熱法交叉比對，兩者差異應在 10% 以內，再把 P_diss 代回公式反算 Q₀。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers; in steady state P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.

steps.title: 表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 射頻場下超導體仍有耗散，因為未配對的準粒子在交變電場中被加速而碰撞。BCS 理論給出表面電阻 R_BCS ∝ (f²/T)·exp(−Δ/k_B T)，其中 Δ 是能隙，鈮的 Δ/k_B ≈ 17.7 K；溫度越低、頻率越低，R_BCS 越小。實際表面電阻 R_s = R_BCS + R_res，殘餘電阻 R_res 來自捕獲磁通、氫化物析出與表面汙染，與溫度無關。品質因數 Q₀ = G/R_s，G 是只由腔形決定的幾何因子，TESLA 腔形 G ≈ 270 Ω。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A superconductor still dissipates under RF because unpaired quasiparticles are accelerated by the alternating field and scatter. BCS theory gives a surface resistance R_BCS ∝ (f²/T)·exp(−Δ/k_B T), where Δ is the energy gap and for niobium Δ/k_B ≈ 17.7 K; lower temperature and lower frequency reduce R_BCS. The real surface resistance is R_s = R_BCS + R_res, where the residual term comes from trapped magnetic flux, hydride precipitation and surface contamination and does not depend on temperature. The quality factor is Q₀ = G/R_s, with G a geometry factor fixed only by the cell shape, about 270 Ω for the TESLA shape. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鈮的表面電阻常用近似式 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω（溫度 T 以 K 計）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A common approximation is R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω with T in kelvin.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鈮的表面電阻常用近似式 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω（溫度 T 以 K 計）。在頻率 f = 1.3 GHz：溫度 T = 2.0 K 時 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.5×0.751×1.46×10⁻⁴ ≈ 11 nΩ；溫度 4.2 K 時 ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.238×0.751×0.0149 ≈ 530 nΩ。加上殘餘電阻 R_res = 5 nΩ，2 K 的總表面電阻 R_s ≈ 16 nΩ，品質因數 Q₀ = 270/16×10⁻⁹ ≈ 1.7×10¹⁰；4.2 K 時 Q₀ 只剩約 5×10⁸。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A common approximation is R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω with T in kelvin. At f = 1.3 GHz: T = 2.0 K gives R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.5×0.751×1.46×10⁻⁴ ≈ 11 nΩ; T = 4.2 K gives ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.238×0.751×0.0149 ≈ 530 nΩ. Adding R_res = 5 nΩ, R_s at 2 K is ≈ 16 nΩ and Q₀ = 270/16×10⁻⁹ ≈ 1.7×10¹⁰, while at 4.2 K Q₀ falls to about 5×10⁸. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在垂直測試中由 4.2 K 緩慢降溫到 1.6 K，每隔 0.2 K 量一次低場 Q₀，畫 R_s = G/Q₀ 對 1/T 的半對數圖：斜率給出能隙 Δ/k_B，1/T → 0 的截距給出 R_res；再與材料與處理紀錄比對是否符合 ≤ 5 nΩ 的殘餘電阻目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During the vertical test cool slowly from 4.2 K to 1.6 K and record low-field Q₀ every 0.2 K; plot R_s = G/Q₀ against 1/T on a semi-log scale.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在垂直測試中由 4.2 K 緩慢降溫到 1.6 K，每隔 0.2 K 量一次低場 Q₀，畫 R_s = G/Q₀ 對 1/T 的半對數圖：斜率給出能隙 Δ/k_B，1/T → 0 的截距給出 R_res；再與材料與處理紀錄比對是否符合 ≤ 5 nΩ 的殘餘電阻目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During the vertical test cool slowly from 4.2 K to 1.6 K and record low-field Q₀ every 0.2 K; plot R_s = G/Q₀ against 1/T on a semi-log scale. The slope yields the gap Δ/k_B and the intercept at 1/T → 0 yields R_res, which is then compared with the ≤ 5 nΩ residual target for the material and treatment lot. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：降溫經過 9.25 K 時若環境磁場未屏蔽到 1 µT 以下，磁通被釘扎在腔壁，每 1 µT 大約增加 0.3 到 1 nΩ 的殘餘電阻，Q₀ 顯著低於 BCS 預測，且怎麼降溫都救不回來，只能回溫重冷。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the ambient field is not shielded below about 1 µT when cooling through 9.25 K, flux is pinned in the wall; each microtesla adds roughly 0.3 to 1 nΩ of residual resistance, Q₀ falls well below the BCS prediction, and no further cooling helps until the cavity is warmed above T_c and re-cooled.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

The slope yields the gap Δ/k_B and the intercept at 1/T → 0 yields R_res, which is then compared with the ≤ 5 nΩ residual target for the material and treatment lot.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 降溫經過 9.25 K 時若環境磁場未屏蔽到 1 µT 以下，磁通被釘扎在腔壁，每 1 µT 大約增加 0.3 到 1 nΩ 的殘餘電阻，Q₀ 顯著低於 BCS 預測，且怎麼降溫都救不回來，只能回溫重冷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 鈮材純度、熱導率與熱崩潰場：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Niobium purity, thermal conductivity and the thermal-breakdown field: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「高 RRR 鈮板與渦電流掃描」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High-RRR niobium sheet and eddy-current scanning” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 腔體用的鈮以殘餘電阻比 RRR ≥ 300 規格採購，RRR 是 300 K 與 4.2 K 正常態電阻的比值，反映間隙雜質（O、N、C、H）與金屬雜質（Ta、W）含量。高 RRR 的意義不在超導本身，而在 4.2 K 以下的熱導率，4.2 K 時 κ ≈ RRR/4 W/(m·K)。射頻表面上若有正常導電的缺陷或夾雜，局部發熱必須經由約 2.8 mm 厚的壁傳到氦槽；熱導率不足時缺陷周圍溫度超過 T_c，正常區域雪崩擴張，即熱崩潰（quench）。板材出廠要做渦電流或 SQUID 掃描找出夾雜，並以拉伸試驗確認深拉所需的延展性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高 RRR 鈮板與渦電流掃描」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cavity niobium is purchased at a residual resistivity ratio RRR ≥ 300, the ratio of normal-state resistivity at 300 K and 4.2 K, which reflects interstitial (O, N, C, H) and metallic (Ta, W) impurities. The value of high RRR is not superconductivity itself but thermal conductivity below 4.2 K, approximately κ ≈ RRR/4 W/(m·K) at 4.2 K. A normal-conducting defect or inclusion on the RF surface heats locally and the heat must cross the roughly 2.8 mm wall to the helium bath; with insufficient conductivity the surrounding temperature exceeds T_c, the normal zone avalanches outward and the cavity quenches. Sheets are eddy-current or SQUID scanned for inclusions and tensile-tested for the ductility needed in deep drawing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “High-RRR niobium sheet and eddy-current scanning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：缺陷模型的熱崩潰磁場 H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)]，a 為缺陷半徑、R_n 為其正常態表面電阻。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The defect model gives the thermal-breakdown field H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)], with a the defect radius and R_n its normal-state surface resistance.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鈮越純越好只是為了提高臨界溫度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Purer niobium matters only because it raises the critical temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「高 RRR 鈮板與渦電流掃描」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 鈮材純度、熱導率與熱崩潰場：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Niobium purity, thermal conductivity and the thermal-breakdown field: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高 RRR 鈮板與渦電流掃描」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High-RRR niobium sheet and eddy-current scanning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：缺陷模型的熱崩潰磁場 H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)]，a 為缺陷半徑、R_n 為其正常態表面電阻。取 κ = 75 W/(m·K)（RRR 300）、T_c − T_b = 9.2 − 2.0 = 7.2 K、a = 50 µm、R_n = 10 mΩ：H_b = √(2160/5×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.6×10⁴ A/m，即 B ≈ 83 mT；以 TESLA 腔 B_pk/E_acc ≈ 4.26 mT/(MV/m) 換算，崩潰梯度約 19 MV/m。若 RRR 只有 40（κ ≈ 10），同一缺陷在約 7 MV/m 就崩潰。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The defect model gives the thermal-breakdown field H_b = √[4κ(T_c − T_b)/(a·R_n)], with a the defect radius and R_n its normal-state surface resistance. For κ = 75 W/(m·K) (RRR 300), T_c − T_b = 9.2 − 2.0 = 7.2 K, a = 50 µm and R_n = 10 mΩ: H_b = √(2160/5×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.6×10⁴ A/m, i.e. B ≈ 83 mT; with the TESLA ratio B_pk/E_acc ≈ 4.26 mT/(MV/m) the quench gradient is about 19 MV/m. With RRR 40 (κ ≈ 10) the same defect quenches near 7 MV/m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每批板材抽樣做四點法 RRR 量測與渦電流掃描，缺陷圖與腔體編號綁定；垂直測試時用溫度圖（T-map）或第二聲（second sound）感測器定位崩潰點，再回頭核對該位置是否對應掃描時標記的夾雜或焊道。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample each sheet lot with four-probe RRR measurement and eddy-current scanning, binding the defect map to the cavity serial number; during the vertical test locate the quench with a temperature map or second-sound sensors and check whether the spot coincides with a flagged inclusion or a weld seam.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 鈮材純度、熱導率與熱崩潰場：量測與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “High-RRR niobium sheet and eddy-current scanning” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每批板材抽樣做四點法 RRR 量測與渦電流掃描，缺陷圖與腔體編號綁定；垂直測試時用溫度圖（T-map）或第二聲（second sound）感測器定位崩潰點，再回頭核對該位置是否對應掃描時標記的夾雜或焊道。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample each sheet lot with four-probe RRR measurement and eddy-current scanning, binding the defect map to the cavity serial number; during the vertical test locate the quench with a temperature map or second-sound sensors and check whether the spot coincides with a flagged inclusion or a weld seam. steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A sheet with low RRR or a tantalum inclusion slipped into the lot produces a cavity that quenches repeatedly below 10 MV/m; because the defect is inside the material, repeated chemistry cannot help and the cavity is scrapped or derated.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “High-RRR niobium sheet and eddy-current scanning” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一片 RRR 偏低或含有 Ta 夾雜的板材混入批次，做出來的腔在 10 MV/m 以下反覆崩潰；因為缺陷在板材內部，再多次化學處理也無效，整支腔只能報廢或降級。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A sheet with low RRR or a tantalum inclusion slipped into the lot produces a cavity that quenches repeatedly below 10 MV/m; because the defect is inside the material, repeated chemistry cannot help and the cavity is scrapped or derated. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sheets are eddy-current or SQUID scanned for inclusions and tensile-tested for the ductility needed in deep drawing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鈮越純越好只是為了提高臨界溫度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Purer niobium matters only because it raises the critical temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 成形、電子束焊接與表面處理鏈：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Forming, electron-beam welding and the surface-treatment chain: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「電子束焊道與電解拋光槽」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Electron-beam weld seams and electropolishing cell” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 半腔由 2.8 mm 鈮板深拉成形，車削邊緣後在真空中以電子束焊接：先在虹膜（iris）焊成啞鈴，啞鈴再於赤道焊接成九腔；赤道焊道位於磁場最強處，焊道底面必須平滑無飛濺。焊接後表面有約 100 到 150 µm 的損傷層，用電解拋光（EP，HF–H₂SO₄ 電解液）或緩衝化學拋光（BCP）移除。接著 800 °C 真空退火數小時除氫，避免降溫時析出氫化鈮；最後再做輕度 EP、超純水高壓沖洗（HPR）、ISO 4 無塵室組裝與 120 °C 烘烤 48 小時，後者可明顯抑制高場 Q 下降。本課只說明公開的工藝邏輯，不含配方細節。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電子束焊道與電解拋光槽」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Half-cells are deep-drawn from 2.8 mm niobium sheet, machined at the edges and electron-beam welded in vacuum: iris welds first join half-cells into dumbbells, then equator welds join the dumbbells into a nine-cell. The equator weld sits where the magnetic field is highest, so its underbead must be smooth and spatter-free. Welding leaves a damage layer of roughly 100 to 150 µm that is removed by electropolishing (EP, an HF–H₂SO₄ electrolyte) or buffered chemical polishing (BCP). A vacuum anneal at 800 °C for several hours then degasses hydrogen so that niobium hydride cannot precipitate on cooldown; a light final EP, ultrapure-water high-pressure rinsing (HPR), ISO 4 cleanroom assembly and a 120 °C bake for 48 hours follow, the bake strongly reducing the high-field Q drop. This course covers only public process logic, not recipes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electron-beam weld seams and electropolishing cell”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：EP 的移除速率由法拉第定律估計：厚度速率 = j·M/(z·F·ρ)，鈮 M = 92.9 g/mol、z = 5、ρ = 8.57 g/cm³、F = 96485 C/mol。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The EP removal rate follows Faraday's law: thickness rate = j·M/(z·F·ρ), with niobium M = 92.9 g/mol, z = 5, ρ = 8.57 g/cm³ and F = 96485 C/mol.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「焊接後只要把表面打磨光亮，射頻性能就會好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "After welding, a mirror-bright mechanical polish is enough for good RF performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「電子束焊道與電解拋光槽」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Electron-beam weld seams and electropolishing cell”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 成形、電子束焊接與表面處理鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Forming, electron-beam welding and the surface-treatment chain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電子束焊道與電解拋光槽」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Electron-beam weld seams and electropolishing cell” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EP 的移除速率由法拉第定律估計：厚度速率 = j·M/(z·F·ρ)，鈮 M = 92.9 g/mol、z = 5、ρ = 8.57 g/cm³、F = 96485 C/mol。取 j = 30 mA/cm²：速率 ≈ 0.03×92.9/(5×96485×8.57) ≈ 6.7×10⁻⁷ cm/s ≈ 0.40 µm/min，移除 150 µm 約需 6.2 小時；一支九腔內表面約 1.2 m²，對應電流約 360 A。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The EP removal rate follows Faraday's law: thickness rate = j·M/(z·F·ρ), with niobium M = 92.9 g/mol, z = 5, ρ = 8.57 g/cm³ and F = 96485 C/mol. For j = 30 mA/cm²: rate ≈ 0.03×92.9/(5×96485×8.57) ≈ 6.7×10⁻⁷ cm/s ≈ 0.40 µm/min, so removing 150 µm takes about 6.2 hours; a nine-cell inner surface of about 1.2 m² corresponds to roughly 360 A of cell current. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：處理前後用超音波測厚儀在每個腔室赤道與虹膜各量壁厚，移除量應與電荷積分推算值一致在 ±10% 內；用內視鏡與複製膜（replica）檢查赤道焊道粗糙度；800 °C 退火後以樣片熱脫附確認氫含量降到數 wt.ppm。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure wall thickness ultrasonically at each equator and iris before and after treatment; the removal must agree with the charge-integrated estimate within ±10%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

For j = 30 mA/cm²: rate ≈ 0.03×92.9/(5×96485×8.57) ≈ 6.7×10⁻⁷ cm/s ≈ 0.40 µm/min, so removing 150 µm takes about 6.2 hours; a nine-cell inner surface of about 1.2 m² corresponds to roughly 360 A of cell current.

steps.title: 成形、電子束焊接與表面處理鏈：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Forming, electron-beam welding and the surface-treatment chain: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「電子束焊道與電解拋光槽」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Electron-beam weld seams and electropolishing cell” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 處理前後用超音波測厚儀在每個腔室赤道與虹膜各量壁厚，移除量應與電荷積分推算值一致在 ±10% 內；用內視鏡與複製膜（replica）檢查赤道焊道粗糙度；800 °C 退火後以樣片熱脫附確認氫含量降到數 wt.ppm。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure wall thickness ultrasonically at each equator and iris before and after treatment; the removal must agree with the charge-integrated estimate within ±10%. Inspect equator welds by borescope and surface replica for roughness, and confirm by witness-sample thermal desorption that hydrogen drops to a few wt. ppm after the 800 °C anneal. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：省略 800 °C 除氫而直接降溫，腔在 100 K 附近停留時析出氫化鈮，Q₀ 在 2 K 掉一個數量級（Q disease）；赤道焊道若有一個 0.5 mm 的焊孔，便成為場發射與崩潰的固定起點。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Skipping the 800 °C degassing and cooling directly lets niobium hydride precipitate during a dwell near 100 K, dropping Q₀ by an order of magnitude at 2 K (Q disease); a single 0.5 mm pinhole in an equator weld becomes a permanent site for field emission and quench.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 處理前後用超音波測厚儀在每個腔室赤道與虹膜各量壁厚，移除量應與電荷積分推算值一致在 ±10% 內；用內視鏡與複製膜（replica）檢查赤道焊道粗糙度；800 °C 退火後以樣片熱脫附確認氫含量降到數 wt.ppm。

Inspect equator welds by borescope and surface replica for roughness, and confirm by witness-sample thermal desorption that hydrogen drops to a few wt. ppm after the 800 °C anneal.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 2 K 垂直測試：Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: 2 K vertical test: the Q₀ versus E_acc curve: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「垂直測試架與衰減時間量測」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vertical test stand and decay-time measurement” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 整支腔在垂直低溫槽內浸入 2 K 超流氦，以可調天線耦合射頻，鎖相迴路追蹤腔頻率。先在低場量射頻關斷後的指數衰減時間 τ，得到負載品質因數 Q_L = ω·τ；由前向與反射功率算出耦合係數 β，Q₀ = Q_L(1 + β)。接著逐步升場，每一點以穩態功率平衡求 P_diss 與儲能 U，得 Q₀(E_acc) 曲線，同時記錄輻射劑量率（場發射）與崩潰梯度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「垂直測試架與衰減時間量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The cavity hangs in a vertical dewar immersed in 2 K superfluid helium, RF is coupled through an adjustable antenna and a phase-locked loop tracks the cavity frequency. At low field the exponential decay time τ after switching the RF off gives the loaded quality factor Q_L = ω·τ; the coupling factor β from forward and reflected power yields Q₀ = Q_L(1 + β). The field is then raised step by step, and at each point the steady-state power balance gives P_diss and the stored energy U, producing the Q₀(E_acc) curve while the radiation dose rate (field emission) and the quench gradient are logged. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Vertical test stand and decay-time measurement”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A measured τ = 1.2 s gives Q_L = 2π×1.3×10⁹×1.2 ≈ 9.8×10⁹; at critical coupling β = 1, Q₀ = 2Q_L ≈ 2.0×10¹⁰.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「Q₀ 是腔的固定常數，量一次低場值就夠了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Q₀ is a fixed constant of the cavity, so one low-field measurement suffices." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「垂直測試架與衰減時間量測」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Vertical test stand and decay-time measurement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 2 K 垂直測試：Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: 2 K vertical test: the Q₀ versus E_acc curve: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「垂直測試架與衰減時間量測」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vertical test stand and decay-time measurement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：量到 τ = 1.2 s：Q_L = 2π×1.3×10⁹×1.2 ≈ 9.8×10⁹；臨界耦合 β = 1 時 Q₀ = 2Q_L ≈ 2.0×10¹⁰。升場後穩態量得 P_diss = 10 W，則 V² = P_diss·(R/Q)·Q₀ = 10×1036×2.0×10¹⁰ ≈ 2.07×10¹⁴，V ≈ 14.4 MV，E_acc = V/1.038 m ≈ 13.9 MV/m。電纜校正誤差 ±0.2 dB 對應功率 ±4.7%，換成場為 ±2.3%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A measured τ = 1.2 s gives Q_L = 2π×1.3×10⁹×1.2 ≈ 9.8×10⁹; at critical coupling β = 1, Q₀ = 2Q_L ≈ 2.0×10¹⁰. With the field raised and a steady-state P_diss = 10 W, V² = P_diss·(R/Q)·Q₀ = 10×1036×2.0×10¹⁰ ≈ 2.07×10¹⁴, V ≈ 14.4 MV and E_acc = V/1.038 m ≈ 13.9 MV/m. A ±0.2 dB cable-calibration error is ±4.7% in power and ±2.3% in field. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次測試前用網路分析儀校正電纜與方向耦合器的衰減；以穿透探針的 Q_t（由衰減量測校定）與 P_trans 做第二條獨立的場校定，兩種方法的 E_acc 差異應小於 5%；比對同一支腔在不同測試架的結果以排除系統誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate cable and coupler attenuation with a network analyzer before every test; use the pickup-probe Q_t (fixed from the decay measurement) with P_trans as a second, independent field calibration and require the two E_acc values to agree within 5%; compare the same cavity on different test stands to expose systematic errors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 2 K 垂直測試：Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: 2 K vertical test: the Q₀ versus E_acc curve: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「垂直測試架與衰減時間量測」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Vertical test stand and decay-time measurement” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每次測試前用網路分析儀校正電纜與方向耦合器的衰減；以穿透探針的 Q_t（由衰減量測校定）與 P_trans 做第二條獨立的場校定，兩種方法的 E_acc 差異應小於 5%；比對同一支腔在不同測試架的結果以排除系統誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate cable and coupler attenuation with a network analyzer before every test; use the pickup-probe Q_t (fixed from the decay measurement) with P_trans as a second, independent field calibration and require the two E_acc values to agree within 5%; compare the same cavity on different test stands to expose systematic errors. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：耦合天線插太深使 β ≫ 1，反射功率量測的微小誤差被放大，Q₀ 被高估兩倍；反之在高場時衰減時間太短無法量測，只能靠功率平衡，電纜一有鬆動就把整條曲線平移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An antenna inserted too deep gives β ≫ 1, so a small error in reflected power is amplified and Q₀ is overestimated by a factor of two; conversely at high field the decay becomes too short to measure, leaving only the power balance, and a loose cable shifts the whole curve.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每次測試前用網路分析儀校正電纜與方向耦合器的衰減；以穿透探針的 Q_t（由衰減量測校定）與 P_trans 做第二條獨立的場校定，兩種方法的 E_acc 差異應小於 5%；比對同一支腔在不同測試架的結果以排除系統誤差。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「珠拉場分佈與勞倫茲力失諧」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bead-pull field profile and Lorentz-force detuning” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 九個腔室必須諧振在同一頻率，否則 π 模式的場在各腔室不等，局部峰值場提早到達崩潰極限。製作後以珠拉法（bead-pull）量軸上場分佈：小珠沿軸移動造成的頻率擾動正比於局部 E²（Slater 擾動定理），得到每腔室的相對振幅，場平坦度定義為 1 − (E_max − E_min)/E_avg，驗收通常要求 ≥ 95%。再以調諧機塑性拉伸或壓縮個別腔室校正頻率，並把整體頻率對準目標。運轉中腔壁受輻射壓力（勞倫茲力）而內凹，頻率隨 E_acc² 下降；加上氦壓波動與機械微震動，構成失諧預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「珠拉場分佈與勞倫茲力失諧」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: All nine cells must resonate at the same frequency; otherwise the π-mode field differs cell to cell and the local peak field reaches the quench limit early. After fabrication a bead-pull measures the on-axis field: the frequency perturbation from a small bead moved along the axis is proportional to the local E² (Slater's theorem), giving each cell's relative amplitude; field flatness is defined as 1 − (E_max − E_min)/E_avg and acceptance usually requires ≥ 95%. A tuning machine then plastically stretches or squeezes individual cells and sets the overall frequency. In operation radiation pressure (the Lorentz force) dents the wall inward so the frequency drops with E_acc²; together with helium-pressure fluctuations and microphonics this forms the detuning budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bead-pull field profile and Lorentz-force detuning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：勞倫茲力失諧 Δf = −K_L·E_acc²，帶加強環的 TESLA 腔 K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)²：在 25 MV/m 時 Δf ≈ −625 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Lorentz-force detuning is Δf = −K_L·E_acc², with K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)² for a stiffened TESLA cavity: at 25 MV/m, Δf ≈ −625 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鈮腔是剛性金屬，射頻場不可能改變它的形狀與頻率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A niobium cavity is rigid metal, so the RF field cannot change its shape or frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「珠拉場分佈與勞倫茲力失諧」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bead-pull field profile and Lorentz-force detuning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：勞倫茲力失諧 Δf = −K_L·E_acc²，帶加強環的 TESLA 腔 K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)²：在 25 MV/m 時 Δf ≈ −625 Hz。負載帶寬 f/Q_L 在 Q_L = 3×10⁶ 時為 1.3×10⁹/3×10⁶ ≈ 433 Hz，失諧超過一個帶寬，脈衝內必須靠壓電調諧器補償；若氦壓靈敏度為 20 Hz/mbar，±1 mbar 的壓力波動再貢獻 ±20 Hz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Lorentz-force detuning is Δf = −K_L·E_acc², with K_L ≈ 1 Hz/(MV/m)² for a stiffened TESLA cavity: at 25 MV/m, Δf ≈ −625 Hz. The loaded bandwidth f/Q_L at Q_L = 3×10⁶ is 1.3×10⁹/3×10⁶ ≈ 433 Hz, so the detuning exceeds one bandwidth and a piezo tuner must compensate within the pulse; with a pressure sensitivity of 20 Hz/mbar, ±1 mbar of helium-pressure ripple adds ±20 Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：室溫下以網路分析儀做珠拉，計算場平坦度與各腔室頻率並記錄調諧前後的數據；低溫測試時量頻率對氦壓的斜率與 Δf 對 E_acc² 的斜率，與設計值 K_L 比對；以頻譜分析儀記錄微震動的 rms 失諧，確認落在預算內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At room temperature run the bead-pull with a network analyzer, compute flatness and per-cell frequencies, and record values before and after tuning; at 2 K measure the frequency slope against helium pressure and Δf against E_acc² and compare with the design K_L; log the rms microphonic detuning with a spectrum analyzer and confirm it fits the budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 氦槽焊接、耦合器與低溫模組整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Helium-vessel welding, couplers and cryomodule integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「氦槽、調諧器與功率耦合器」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Helium vessel, tuner and power coupler” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 通過垂直測試的腔被焊進鈦製氦槽，鈦與鈮的熱收縮相近且可電子束焊接；槽上裝慢速步進調諧器與快速壓電元件，透過拉伸整支腔改變頻率。基波功率耦合器把室溫波導功率經陶瓷窗送入 2 K 的腔，外部品質因數 Q_ext 依束流負載選定；高階模耦合器把束流激發的寄生模導出。八支腔在無塵室內串接成腔串，與雙相氦管、熱屏、磁屏蔽與真空容器一起組成低溫模組。靜態漏熱與動態射頻耗散共同決定 2 K 製冷機的規模。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氦槽、調諧器與功率耦合器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A cavity that passes the vertical test is welded into a titanium helium vessel, titanium matching niobium in thermal contraction and being electron-beam weldable; the vessel carries a slow stepper tuner and a fast piezo element that change frequency by stretching the whole cavity. The fundamental power coupler brings room-temperature waveguide power through a ceramic window into the 2 K cavity, its external quality factor Q_ext chosen for the beam loading; higher-order-mode couplers extract beam-excited parasitic modes. Eight cavities are assembled into a string in the cleanroom and, with the two-phase helium line, thermal shields, magnetic shielding and vacuum vessel, form a cryomodule. Static heat leak plus dynamic RF dissipation set the size of the 2 K refrigerator. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Helium vessel, tuner and power coupler”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：2 K 製冷的卡諾功比為 (300 − 2)/2 = 149；大型氦製冷機效率約 20% 到 25%，故每瓦 2 K 熱負載約需 600 到 750 W 電力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The Carnot work ratio for 2 K refrigeration is (300 − 2)/2 = 149; large helium plants reach 20 to 25% of Carnot, so each watt at 2 K costs roughly 600 to 750 W of electricity.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「垂直測試合格的腔，裝進模組後性能一定相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cavity that passed the vertical test will perform identically inside the module." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「氦槽、調諧器與功率耦合器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 氦槽焊接、耦合器與低溫模組整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Helium-vessel welding, couplers and cryomodule integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氦槽、調諧器與功率耦合器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Helium vessel, tuner and power coupler” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：2 K 製冷的卡諾功比為 (300 − 2)/2 = 149；大型氦製冷機效率約 20% 到 25%，故每瓦 2 K 熱負載約需 600 到 750 W 電力。一個模組若有 8 支腔各 10 W 動態耗散加 10 W 靜態漏熱，2 K 負載 90 W，電力約 54 到 68 kW；若 Q₀ 從 2.7×10¹⁰ 退化到 1×10¹⁰，動態負載升到 216 W，電力需求幾乎三倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The Carnot work ratio for 2 K refrigeration is (300 − 2)/2 = 149; large helium plants reach 20 to 25% of Carnot, so each watt at 2 K costs roughly 600 to 750 W of electricity. A module with 8 cavities at 10 W dynamic each plus 10 W static leak has a 90 W load at 2 K, about 54 to 68 kW of electrical power; if Q₀ degrades from 2.7×10¹⁰ to 1×10¹⁰ the dynamic load rises to 216 W and the power demand nearly triples. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：氦槽焊接後重做頻率與場平坦度量測，確認焊接變形在調諧範圍內；耦合器在測試台上以行波與駐波模式老化（conditioning）到額定功率，記錄真空與電子活動；模組冷卻後以氦流量與溫度感測器分離靜態與動態熱負載，與設計預算逐項比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Re-measure frequency and flatness after vessel welding to confirm the distortion lies within the tuner range; condition the coupler on a test stand in travelling- and standing-wave modes up to rated power while logging vacuum and electron activity; after the module cools, separate static and dynamic heat loads with helium flow and temperature sensors and compare line by line with the design budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

A module with 8 cavities at 10 W dynamic each plus 10 W static leak has a 90 W load at 2 K, about 54 to 68 kW of electrical power; if Q₀ degrades from 2.7×10¹⁰ to 1×10¹⁰ the dynamic load rises to 216 W and the power demand nearly triples.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「氦槽、調諧器與功率耦合器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Helium vessel, tuner and power coupler” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 氦槽焊接後重做頻率與場平坦度量測，確認焊接變形在調諧範圍內；耦合器在測試台上以行波與駐波模式老化（conditioning）到額定功率，記錄真空與電子活動；模組冷卻後以氦流量與溫度感測器分離靜態與動態熱負載，與設計預算逐項比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Re-measure frequency and flatness after vessel welding to confirm the distortion lies within the tuner range; condition the coupler on a test stand in travelling- and standing-wave modes up to rated power while logging vacuum and electron activity; after the module cools, separate static and dynamic heat loads with helium flow and temperature sensors and compare line by line with the design budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：無塵室組裝時一粒微米級顆粒落入腔內，模組測試時場發射在 15 MV/m 就起跳，整個模組必須回溫、拆串、重新沖洗，損失數週；耦合器陶瓷窗若鍍膜不當，多路徑放電（multipacting）讓功率上不去。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A single micrometre particle dropped into the cavity during string assembly makes field emission start at 15 MV/m in the module test, forcing warm-up, disassembly and re-rinsing that costs weeks; a poorly coated coupler ceramic window multipacts and blocks the power ramp.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 氦槽焊接後重做頻率與場平坦度量測，確認焊接變形在調諧範圍內；耦合器在測試台上以行波與駐波模式老化（conditioning）到額定功率，記錄真空與電子活動；模組冷卻後以氦流量與溫度感測器分離靜態與動態熱負載，與設計預算逐項比較。

quiz.question: 要驗證「氦槽焊接、耦合器與低溫模組整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

quiz.explanationEn: Re-measure frequency and flatness after vessel welding to confirm the distortion lies within the tuner range; condition the coupler on a test stand in travelling- and standing-wave modes up to rated power while logging vacuum and electron activity; after the module cools, separate static and dynamic heat loads with helium flow and temperature sensors and compare line by line with the design budget. steps.instruction: 無塵室組裝時一粒微米級顆粒落入腔內，模組測試時場發射在 15 MV/m 就起跳，整個模組必須回溫、拆串、重新沖洗，損失數週；耦合器陶瓷窗若鍍膜不當，多路徑放電（multipacting）讓功率上不去。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 驗收判準、統計與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Acceptance criteria, statistics and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「腔體履歷卡與可用梯度定義」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cavity traveler and the usable-gradient definition” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量產腔的驗收不是單一數字，而是一組可追溯的紀錄：板材 RRR 與掃描圖、焊接參數、化學移除量、退火與烘烤紀錄、珠拉數據、每次垂直測試的 Q₀(E_acc) 曲線、輻射劑量與崩潰位置。可用梯度定義為三者的最小值：崩潰梯度扣除安全邊際、Q₀ 仍高於規格的梯度、場發射輻射低於限值的梯度。未達標的腔依失效原因決定重做 HPR、重做輕度 EP 或退回重新焊接；統計上的良率決定需要多少備用腔。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「腔體履歷卡與可用梯度定義」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance of production cavities is a traceable record rather than one number: sheet RRR and scan maps, weld parameters, chemical removal, anneal and bake logs, bead-pull data, every vertical-test Q₀(E_acc) curve, radiation dose and quench location. The usable gradient is the minimum of three values: the quench gradient minus a safety margin, the gradient at which Q₀ still meets specification, and the gradient at which field-emission radiation stays below the limit. Cavities that fall short are routed by failure cause to a repeat HPR, a light EP or a return to welding; the statistical yield sets how many spare cavities to order. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cavity traveler and the usable-gradient definition”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：某腔崩潰於 30 MV/m，扣 10% 邊際得 27 MV/m；Q₀ 在 28 MV/m 降到 1×10¹⁰ 的規格線；輻射在 26 MV/m 超過限值，則可用梯度 = min(27, 28, 26) = 26 MV/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A cavity quenching at 30 MV/m gives 27 MV/m after a 10% margin; Q₀ crosses the 1×10¹⁰ specification at 28 MV/m; radiation exceeds the limit at 26 MV/m, so the usable gradient is min(27, 28, 26) = 26 MV/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「腔體最高梯度就是它在加速器中的運轉梯度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cavity's maximum gradient is the gradient it will run at in the accelerator." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「腔體履歷卡與可用梯度定義」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Cavity traveler and the usable-gradient definition”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 驗收判準、統計與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance criteria, statistics and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「腔體履歷卡與可用梯度定義」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cavity traveler and the usable-gradient definition” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某腔崩潰於 30 MV/m，扣 10% 邊際得 27 MV/m；Q₀ 在 28 MV/m 降到 1×10¹⁰ 的規格線；輻射在 26 MV/m 超過限值，則可用梯度 = min(27, 28, 26) = 26 MV/m。若規格是 23.6 MV/m 且 800 支腔中 75% 第一次就過，另 20% 經重做 HPR 後通過，總良率 95%，為交付 800 支合格腔需投產約 842 支。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A cavity quenching at 30 MV/m gives 27 MV/m after a 10% margin; Q₀ crosses the 1×10¹⁰ specification at 28 MV/m; radiation exceeds the limit at 26 MV/m, so the usable gradient is min(27, 28, 26) = 26 MV/m. If the specification is 23.6 MV/m and 75% of 800 cavities pass first time while another 20% pass after a repeat HPR, the overall yield is 95% and about 842 cavities must be produced to deliver 800 accepted ones. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接審查時抽樣核對履歷卡的每一項是否有量測值、單位與日期，Q₀ 曲線是否附校正證據；把全批可用梯度畫成直方圖與累積分佈，和專案規格與模組排程比對；確認備用腔數量與再處理產能足以覆蓋統計上的低尾端。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At the handoff review sample traveler entries for measured value, unit and date, and check that each Q₀ curve carries its calibration evidence; histogram the usable gradients of the whole lot with a cumulative distribution against the project specification and module schedule; confirm that spares and reprocessing capacity cover the statistical low tail.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 驗收判準、統計與工程交接：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「腔體履歷卡與可用梯度定義」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cavity traveler and the usable-gradient definition” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 交接審查時抽樣核對履歷卡的每一項是否有量測值、單位與日期，Q₀ 曲線是否附校正證據；把全批可用梯度畫成直方圖與累積分佈，和專案規格與模組排程比對；確認備用腔數量與再處理產能足以覆蓋統計上的低尾端。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At the handoff review sample traveler entries for measured value, unit and date, and check that each Q₀ curve carries its calibration evidence; histogram the usable gradients of the whole lot with a cumulative distribution against the project specification and module schedule; confirm that spares and reprocessing capacity cover the statistical low tail. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只以崩潰梯度排序腔體而忽略場發射紀錄，裝進模組後輻射使鄰近電子元件與低溫絕緣劣化，加速器被迫以低於設計的梯度運轉。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Ranking cavities by quench gradient alone while ignoring the field-emission record puts radiation sources into the module that degrade nearby electronics and cryogenic insulation, and the accelerator runs below design gradient.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

quiz.question: 要驗證「驗收判準、統計與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.instruction: 只以崩潰梯度排序腔體而忽略場發射紀錄，裝進模組後輻射使鄰近電子元件與低溫絕緣劣化，加速器被迫以低於設計的梯度運轉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Ranking cavities by quench gradient alone while ignoring the field-emission record puts radiation sources into the module that degrade nearby electronics and cryogenic insulation, and the accelerator runs below design gradient. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：未達標的腔依失效原因決定重做 HPR、重做輕度 EP 或退回重新焊接；統計上的良率決定需要多少備用腔。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cavities that fall short are routed by failure cause to a repeat HPR, a light EP or a return to welding; the statistical yield sets how many spare cavities to order.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「腔體最高梯度就是它在加速器中的運轉梯度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A cavity's maximum gradient is the gradient it will run at in the accelerator." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
